general.name: Java - Uninstall All Versions [Win]
general.description:
Uninstalls every standalone Java JRE/JDK from any vendor and cleans leftovers; Report mode lists them without changes.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Scripts/java-uninstall-all-versions-win

variables.name: usrMode
variables.description: Remove = uninstall every standalone Java not matched by usrKeep and clean up. Report = list what Remove would do and change nothing.

variables.name: usrKeep
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated text matched against product and folder names; matches are left installed, e.g. Java 8 Update 401. Each term at least 3 characters.

variables.name: usrUdfNumber
variables.description: UDF to write a one-line summary to, 1 to 300. Blank = write no UDF. Never overwrites a value another component wrote.
